Large trucks cannot simply force out the small vehicles because they are in the way. Open, predictable, non-discriminatory rules allow countries with different market sizes to productively trade with each other. Otherwise, countries with the largest market will dictate the rules. Thank you, Chair. The members of the Customs Cooperation Council, also known as the World Customs Organization or WCO, are responsible for managing more than 98% of world trade. International trade is an engine for development, therefore cannot succeed without customs serving as an effective implementing agency. The WCO maintains several international instruments which are vital to the multilateral trading system. Acknowledging two of these will help make the FFD4 outcome document more concrete and actionable. First is the International Convention on the Simplification and Harmonization of Customs Procedures, known as the WCO Revised Kyoto Convention, or RKC. This convention is the blueprint for modern and efficient customs procedures and currently has 136 contracting parties, 92 of whom are developing countries. Supporting their adherence to the convention is key to their effective integration to the rules-based multilateral trading system, therefore supporting customs implementation of the WCO RKC should be added specifically among the points listed under action 37 of the outcome document. Second, the WCO Harmonized Commodity Description and Coding System, known as the WCO Harmonized System, or HS, is a product nomenclature used by more than 200 countries and economies as a basis for their customs tariffs and for the collection of international trade statistics. Effective application of the HS is critical to the success of any national or international policies relating to controls and tariffs on commodities. Supporting customs implementation of the WCO harmonized system and aligning recognition of trade flows should be included within action 36 of the outcome document. The WCO will submit this statement in writing alongside more specific text proposals for additional opportunities where customs and its instruments could be more explicitly recognized in the text. Thank you.
